The daily job now refreshes the role forecast, and the AI labeller is still off

Long image

A

Answer

Each daily run refreshes the role forecast and logs it. The open month is blended toward last month. The AI labeller is built, but it stays off until it beats the title regex on a hand-checked set.

  1. The daily job starts from the newest stored snapshot, so ledger rows and months survive a fresh container.
  2. The open month is blended with last month. The blend weight depends on how many days the thread has been open.
  3. A forecast row is graded 12 months later. No row has a grade yet.

Applies toPhases 2 to 7 and the AI labellerworking tree at 29 Oct 2026Phase 5 not builtno AI credits yet

2

What happens in one daily run?

Diagram structure
  • Daily job sched
  • refresh() refresh
  • Hacker News hn
  • Claude labeller llm
  • Role files and ledger roles
  • App Storage store
  • sched → refresh · run: load newest snapshot
  • refresh → hn · fetch newest thread
  • hn → refresh · thread and posts
  • refresh → llm · label new posts, only if the switch is llm
  • llm → refresh · labels for every post
  • refresh → roles · role demand, trends, backtest, forecast
  • roles → refresh · role_forecast.json
  • refresh → roles · write ledger row, grade old rows
  • refresh → store · save snapshot, latest.json last
  • store → sched · ok
  • llm → refresh · no answer, LabellerUnavailable
  • refresh → roles · restore old role files, skills kept
  • refresh → sched · ok, with roles_updated false
  • refresh → store · upload fails before latest.json
  • store → sched · exit 1, latest.json unchanged
  • The labeller branch is off today. Only a role_labeller.json that says llm turns Claude on.
  • A role failure does not fail the run. The skills stay new, and the snapshot keeps the old role files.
3

How does one forecast row end?

Diagram structure
  • Row written written
  • Waiting waiting
  • Graded graded
  • Hit hit
  • Miss miss
  • Replaced replaced
  • written → waiting · saved
  • waiting → graded · month complete
  • graded → hit · in band
  • graded → miss · outside band
  • written → replaced · same-day rerun

A row is written on each daily run. It waits until its target month, as of plus 12 months, is complete in the role demand table. A later run then grades it. Hit means the actual share falls inside the low to high band.

4

How does the open month get blended?

Diagram structure
  • Posts and mentions so far counts
  • Pick k for that day kq
  • Blend toward last month blend
  • Forecast 12 months fc
  • Last month share last
  • Days since thread opened days
  • blend → fc · nowcast y
  • counts → blend · m and n
  • days → kq
  • kq → blend · k
  • last → blend · s_prev

A complete month has no open thread, so the blend is off: the series uses the raw share. k is 0 from day 14, which also gives the raw share.

The blend is (m + k × s_prev) / (n + k), where m and n are the open month's mentions and posts. s_prev is last month's smoothed share. A thread with 40 posts and k = 100 gives its posts 40 of 140 weight, about 29%. That is an example, not a measured value.

The chart below comes from data/nowcast_backtest.json. It shows roles on held-out months from 2024-07, as mean absolute error in percentage points.

The blend cuts day-1 error by about 0.11 pp. A near-pure last-month baseline (k = 1600) is worse, at 1.05 pp on day 1. From day 14 the blend is off (k = 0).

5

When does the AI labeller switch on?

  1. Rules (now)

    Title regex decides roles. role_labeller.json is missing, so the switch is off.

  2. Sample 200 posts

    python -m engine.llm_labels sample --n 200 writes a sheet with an empty gold column. Not run yet.

  3. Hand-label the gold set

    Fill gold_roles by hand. Eval needs at least 100 labelled posts.

  4. Claude must win

    Switch to llm only if Claude has the higher micro F1 than the regex. Otherwise stay on rules.

  5. LLM on (daily)

    Each daily run labels only new posts. Labels are cached by post id.

  6. Backfill all history

    backfill --yes relabels every post, so one series never mixes labellers.

  7. Claude unreachable

    The role step fails and the old role files come back. Skills and the snapshot still save.

6

What is not built, and what are the risks?

Not built

Phase 5 is not built. Malaysian boards need written permission from Hiredly and Jobstore first. A second source and news momentum need months of history before a backtest can judge them. The AI labeller has not run. There are no AI credits, so there is no gold set and no eval.

  • The Replit Scheduled Deployment is not set up. The in-process cron at 06:30 runs only while an instance is alive. 1
  • A failed role step still reports success. The summary shows roles_updated false, but not the error text. The snapshot is saved with the old role files. 2
  • A Claude outage takes the same path as a role failure. New posts keep the old labels, and the month waits for the next run.
  • Track record is empty for about 12 months, because rows grade only when their target month is complete.
  • The nowcast k values come from one backtest. The gain is small: about 0.11 pp on day 1.
  • Source line numbers point to the working tree. The files are not committed, so the lines are not pinned to a commit.
